judged_text: Every best request for an unknown embed_url enqueues a RetrieveTopic job with no enqueue-side dedup; the 60-second throttle lives only inside the job. A popular article whose import keeps failing (or before the first job runs) enqueues one Sidekiq job per page view, flooding the queue with no-op jobs that each still hit Redis and the database.

adjudication.rationale: In EmbedController#best, when TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url) is nil it unconditionally calls Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ... embed_url: embed_url) on every request and renders 'loading'. There is no enqueue-side deduplication or throttle in the controller/job enqueue path. The only 60s throttle is inside TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently? (called during the job’s execution), so many identical Sidekiq jobs can still be queued before any runs or if retrieval repeatedly fails. This is a concrete, diff-grounded queue/throughput concern rather than a functional correctness defect.
